title: Chris Morris Upper Deck 1993-1994 #56
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This Chris Morris Upper Deck sports trading card is a must-have for any fan of the National Basketball Association (NBA). The card features Morris in his New Jersey Nets uniform during the 1993-94 season and is part of the base set from Upper Deck. It has a card number of 56 and is in near-mint or better condition, making it a great addition to any sports trading card collection.
The card is not autographed and is ungraded, but that does not detract from its value as a collectible item. It was manufactured in 1994 and is a great representation of Morris' skills as a player. If you're looking to add a Chris Morris Upper Deck card to your collection, this is the one to get.
